proposed.text: What types of monetary damages may an architect recover in a copyright infringement case under RA 8293?

options.text: Only the cost to record or deposit copyright documents
Actual damages, legal costs and expenses, plus infringer profits, or court-determined just damages in lieu of actual damages and profits
A fixed fee of PHP 100,000 regardless of actual loss or infringer profits
Only the original design fee, with no possible recovery for expenses or infringer profits

rationale.a: Registration, recording, or deposit cost is not the damages measure in Section 216.
rationale.c: Section 216 does not set this fixed fee.
rationale.d: Section 216 is broader than the original design fee.
rationale.correct: RA 8293 Section 216.1(b) allows actual damages, legal costs, other expenses, and profits the infringer made, or in lieu of actual damages and profits, just damages that are not a penalty. Section 226 adds the four-year damages limit. The local source does not support a fixed PHP 250,000 statutory-damages formulation for this item.
rationale.takeaway: Use the Section 216 damages language, and remember the Section 226 timing limit.
